c.thesis: The visitor stops reading a flat diagram and finds themselves standing over a physical survey model of Chicago on a museum table under raking light; the century presses into the paper as it happens, the camera leans in to whatever the text is touching, and when the table finally tips, the money owed stands up off the map at true height.
c.threeD: ONE language, "the map is a physical object on a table," expressed through exactly three registers that share a single light source (raking from the northwest) and never mix metaphors. (1) THE TILT. The whole `.ground-stage` wrapper gets a CSS camera, `perspective: 1400px` on the shell, `transform: rotateX(Ndeg)` on the stage, `transform-style: preserve-3d`, with N a DISCRETE per-step value (0deg for all reading states, 18deg at the act0 opening, 24deg at the act6 money beats, capped 10-12deg on mobile). The SVG viewBox tween and the CSS tilt compose independently (viewBox on the svg element, transform on the wrapper), so the existing server-rendered subtree is never re-rendered. A CSS `filter: drop-shadow()` on `.ground-svg` whose offset grows with tilt sells the map as a sheet lifted off a cream-dark table surface (the stage backdrop becomes `cream-dark` "table," the map paper stays cream, so even the sparsest era reads as paper-on-table, never void). (2) THE PRESS. Intaglio depth for the grades, quantized and ordinal per the R7 ruling. The five merged per-grade fill paths (data-gfill, NOT the 694 tap-target .ga paths, which stay filter-free for perf and DOM contract) each get an inner-shadow treatment at four discrete rank steps, A shallowest to D pressed deepest into the paper. Build as an SVG filter per grade (feOffset dx=1..3 dy=1..3 of SourceAlpha, feGaussianBlur 0.5..1.5, feComposite operator=out with SourceAlpha, feFlood ink at 0.25..0.45, composited atop the fill) or, if Safari profiling objects, the cheap twin, two stroked clones per grade path (dark hairline offset NW-in, paper highlight SE-in). Grade fill opacity simultaneously rises from the current pastel wash to full-strength period ink so the city stops reading as confetti. On-page disclosure line beneath the map at the first pressed state, in the plat caps style, reading "Depth shows the grade's rank on the surveyors' scale, not a measured quantity." The register wall bars receive the same intaglio, because the instruments are what pressed the marks into the city; one language across map and wall. (3) THE STANDING MONEY. Dollar figures have true magnitude, so only they may rise OFF the table. At the act6 money beats, tower elements (absolutely positioned HTML divs inside the preserve-3d stage, placed by the same anchor-to-percent math StageController already uses for notes) counter-rotate `rotateX(-24deg)` so they stand perpendicular to the tilted table at their true geography (North Lawndale for the contract-sale extraction total, the citywide gap figure at the Loop anchor, East Woodlawn 2026 beside the rust ring), height in px linearly proportional to dollars with a drawn scale key on the table edge. Real DOM, real labels, real sources, discrete resolved heights. WHERE 3D DELIBERATELY DOES NOT APPEAR: ch4 the memorial (zero tilt, zero press, zero shadow play, the dim field stays exactly the R9 gray), every document scene (a3-deed, a3-article34, a5-twobuyers read flat and frontal like paper on a reading desk), the register wall (an instrument panel read straight on), and every long-reading state (tilt exists only at the act0 threshold and the act6 money beats; all map-reading happens overhead flat, because a tilted map is theater and a flat map is evidence).
c.camera: The camera is a gantry over the model table with two axes, zoom (rAF interpolation of the four viewBox numbers between discrete crops, cubic ease, 900-1200ms, roughly 30 lines, no dependency) and tilt (CSS transition on the wrapper transform). Every step's registry entry gains a CameraState {viewBox, tiltDeg, spot} where spot is an anchor key that positions a raking-light pool, an SVG mask over a dim rect whose feathered hole (radial-gradient-masked circle, radius per step) translates to the named anchor; everything outside the pool drops to about 60 percent ink. The tween is presentation; the resolved state is information. ARRIVE-EARLY RULE, no camera move ever lands ON a solemn or load-bearing beat; the move happens on the preceding step so the beat itself is still. Act by act. ACT0 (ch0, a0-charge, a0-locate). First paint is the full 1940 map at rotateX(18deg) with the long NW shadow, the walk-up-to-the-table moment, pure SSR since tilt is a CSS default on the initial data attributes. Scrolling into ch0's takeaway eases the table flat to 0deg for reading. a0-locate pulses the spotlight pool on the visitor's found area. ACT1 (ch1, ch2, ch3, a1-plat, a1-fair, a1-wells). One continuous zoom from citywide into the township frame replacing today's hard cut; the ground strips back to 1832 en route (grades out, section grid in). a1-fair moves the pool onto the real Jackson Park polygon; a1-wells moves it to the Wells anchor. ACT2 (a2-overture, a2-register, a2-docket, then ch4). Pull back to citywide; the map pane holds lake plus whisper fabric plus era readout so the register wall never again sits beside bare cream (the d-a2-register fix). The step BEFORE ch4 completes the cut to the Black Belt crop; on ch4 itself the camera is frozen. ACT3 (ch5, a3-deed, a3-article34, a3-s1, a3-hansberry, a3-cases, a3-flood f1-f3, a3-s2). Covenant beats hold the Black Belt crop with counter-scaled marks so the 32 incidents finally read (the d-ch5 fix); the pool follows named addresses, Binga's block included. The flood is the page's one long move, a single slow pull-back from Black Belt to citywide across f1 to f3 while the filed batches settle in sheet order, so the widening frame itself performs "the map fills"; a3-s2 arrives overhead, flat, full ink, full press. ACT4 (ch8, a4-clearance, a4-baldwin). Zoom into the township; 1955 ground fabric appears (streets, the 55 park polygons); the pool tracks the areas the text names. ACT5 (a5-basement, a5-twobuyers). Cut to Black Belt crop, pool on North Lawndale; document scenes flat. ACT6 (ch11, a6-ledger, a6-climb, a6-bridge, a6-sum, a6-wall, a6-receipt, a6-colophon). The table tips to 24deg exactly once, bookending act0, and the dollar towers stand up for the ledger, climb, and bridge beats; a6-sum returns overhead flat for the final one-map read with the rust ring; the colophon lets the table settle back toward the opening angle, the model at rest. REDUCED-MOTION RESOLUTION: prefers-reduced-motion disables every tween (viewBox set instantly, transform transition none, sheets and towers appear at resolved values), and because every step already resolves to a discrete CameraState, keyboard, phone, and reduced-motion visitors land on pixel-identical states; the verify suite asserts the resolved state per step, never the tween.
c.groundPlane: A strata system where every layer names its source and at least two strata are visible in every one of the 54 steps (enforced, see new ideas). ALWAYS PRESENT: the cream-dark table surface, the paper sheet with its shadow, and Lake Michigan as a true polygon derived from the eastern hull of the 77 community areas (data/exhibit-src/community-areas.geojson), filled with water-lining, an SVG pattern of horizontal hairlines that is a genuine 19th-century engraving convention applied to real geometry, replacing d-ch1's flat gray slab. 1832-1889 (ch1, a1-plat): the PLSS one-mile section grid computed from the same State/Madison 800-units-per-mile arithmetic the bombing geocoder already uses, hairline, era-honest since the section grid IS the 1830s survey instrument; plus township boundary and shoreline. 1893 (a1-fair): Jackson Park, Washington Park, and the Midway from the real park geometry (parks-cpd.geojson citywide, hp-frame-layers.json's 55 unused polygons in the township frame), the fair's true footprint labeled on Jackson Park. 1900-1933 (a2, ch4, ch5, a3 covenant beats): the 77 community areas as whisper hairline fabric plus major streets (data/exhibit-src/major-streets.geojson) at low ink inside the Black Belt crop, so the covenant era sits in a city instead of d-ch5's blank paper; ch4 keeps its existing dim gray treatment of exactly this fabric, unchanged. 1934-1968 (a3-flood, a3-s2, act4): grade fills at full ink with press depth over the fabric. 1949-1963 township frame (ch8, a4-clearance): street fabric clipped to the frame plus the 55 park polygons plus the township line; the Hyde Park-Kenwood renewal-area boundary gets drawn ONLY if it is sourced from the city data portal as an R10 sourcing task, otherwise clearance stays told by spotlight and text, no invented footprint. 1971-2026 (ch11, a6): everything summed plus the rust today ring and, on money beats, the towers. Mobile gets the identical strata so m-ch0 reads as a city with a lake, not floating chips.
c.register: Both register surfaces adopt the table's intaglio language and both draw the relay instead of stating it. THE DOCKED STRIP becomes the relay gauge. Five rows at 6px bar height minimum (today's 1px hairlines die), each labeled with a short word in plat caps, RULE, DEED, MAP, BULLDOZER, CONTRACT, replacing the cryptic floating initials R C M U S. Beneath the five, one new UNION BAND, solid ink wherever any instrument is running, computed from the real interval dates; unbroken paper never shows through it between 1921 and 1970, which makes the thesis visible at a glance. The rust playhead line carries the year; instruments active at the playhead lift (ink darkens plus a 1px raised highlight, the same raking light). Two-second read, five named bars, one unbroken band, a rust now-line. THE WALL (a2-register) keeps its studied layout but the bars are pressed into the paper with the same inner-shadow treatment as the D-grade fills, because these are the instruments that did the pressing. Start and end years become engraved ticks. Below the five bars the union band draws itself left to right as the visitor arrives (presentation only; resolved state is the full band), with a labeled bracket spanning 1921-1970 reading "no year the machinery was off." The relay claim gets literal BATON-PASS LINKS, vertical hairlines at each real end date connecting the dying instrument to whichever bar is already running that year, 1948 covenants down to the map, 1950 the rule down to the map, 1968 the map down to the bulldozer, 1970 the contract down to the bulldozer. Every link is a pair of true dates; nothing is invented. A stranger reads the wall in two seconds as five overlapping tools passing a baton with no gap.
newIdeas: The union band with baton-pass links, the relay thesis computed from real interval dates and drawn as an unbroken coverage bar plus dated hand-off hairlines, on both the wall and the docked strip

Counter-scaled marks, the 32 bombing incidents and the today ring hold a constant screen size across every crop (radius reset per frame state by the controller, or vector-effect non-scaling-stroke for ring strokes), so symbol size never lies with zoom and d-ch5's 2px knot becomes 32 legible incidents

The raking-light spotlight pool, one SVG-masked dim layer whose feathered hole translates between per-step anchors, giving every chapter a lit subject (Binga's block, Jackson Park, North Lawndale, the renewal area, East Woodlawn) without ever restyling the data itself

The bare-cream assertion, the verify suite gains a per-step contract asserting the resolved CameraState plus at least two visible ground strata plus minimum on-screen mark size, which operationalizes the owner's 'check every map' as a permanent regression gate across all 54 steps
c.ch4AndHonesty: CH4 KEEPS ITS DIGNITY BY EXPLICIT EXEMPTION, encoded in the registry, not left to taste. Its CameraState is {Black Belt crop, tilt 0, spot none} and the cut to that crop completes on the preceding step, so on the memorial itself nothing moves at all. No press depth, no spotlight pool, no shadow choreography, no towers, no sheet-settle; the R9 treatment (dim field over the real community fabric, 32 counter-scaled marks, the dashed commission square) is preserved verbatim except for one composition fix, re-centering the crop a quarter-mile east so the marks stop hugging the left third. The only permitted motion is the existing slow static reveal, and under reduced motion even that resolves instantly to the identical frame. The dead stay counted, not named. EVERY LAYER STAYS REAL DATA: the lake and neighborhood fabric come from the fetched community-areas.geojson, parks from the Chicago Park District geojson and the 55 polygons already cached in hp-frame-layers.json, streets from major-streets.geojson, the section grid from the same State/Madison survey arithmetic already trusted for bombing geocoding, marks and the commission square and the township line and East Woodlawn from the verified extracts, tower heights and the climb and bridge figures from the sourced dollar registry, and every stratum is named with its source in the colophon. Depth is presentation of ordinal rank in quantized steps with an on-page disclosure, per the R7 ruling; only dollars extrude continuously because only dollars have true magnitude. Nothing decorative is invented; the two texture moves (water-lining, intaglio) are rendering conventions applied to real geometry, and the one uncertain layer (the 1955 renewal boundary) ships only if sourced from the city portal, otherwise it is omitted rather than faked.
c.risks: (1) SVG filter cost, inner shadows on five merged grade paths should be cheap but Safari's filter compositor is erratic; mitigation is the pre-built fallback of paired offset-stroke clones, decided by profiling on a mid-tier phone before the technique is locked, and filters never touch the 694 .ga tap-target paths. (2) Double-transform interactions, CSS perspective tilt on the wrapper plus rAF viewBox tween on the svg compose in theory but need explicit testing on iOS Safari for rasterization blur at tilt; mitigation is will-change discipline and snapping tilt to 0 during any viewBox tween so the two axes never animate simultaneously. (3) Legibility under tilt, foreshortened SVG text is unreadable, so all map labels hide during tilted states and only counter-rotated HTML overlays (era, note, tower labels) speak; if the act0 tilted opening tests as confusing rather than arresting, the fallback is a smaller 10deg threshold tilt. (4) Skeuomorphic kitsch, a table metaphor can rot into wood-texture theater; the guardrail is that the table is flat cream-dark with no texture, all depth comes from light, and the blind taste test from R7 gates the intaglio pass. (5) Tower overlay drift, HTML towers must track viewBox crops via the existing anchor-percentage math and will misregister if a tween is interrupted mid-flight; mitigation is deriving their positions from the resolved CameraState only and hiding them during tweens. (6) Scope, the flood pull-back plus strata system plus register rebuild is the critical path; if the schedule bites, the cut order is sheet-settle first, act0 tilt second, never the ground strata or the union band, because the owner's core complaints (bare cream, unreadable marks, cryptic register) die with those two.

c.conceptName: The Plate and the Bill (rostrum-camera document world; grades pressed down, dollars stacked up)
c.thesis: The map stops reading as a colored diagram floating in cream and becomes a physical printed plate lying on a survey table that the camera can lean over, so the visitor feels the century as pressure, the grades pressed down into the paper in ranked steps and the dollar bill stacked up on top of it in true magnitude.
c.threeD: ONE language, the intaglio print on the rostrum table, built entirely on the existing server-rendered SVG plus CSS 3D on its wrapper. No WebGL, no new dependency; the R7 WebGL terrain stays retired because a second renderer would split the material language. Three physical facts make the world: (1) THE PLATE. The paper rect gains a debossed plate-mark (a rectangle sized to the citywide extent with a 1px light stroke on its south/east inner edge and 1px shadow stroke north/west, standard intaglio furniture), plus engraved document furniture set in the margins as real artifact detail, a title block transcribed from the actual HOLC sheet inscription, a scale bar derived from the 800-units-per-mile grid arithmetic, a north arrow, and the corner date stamp. Empty states now read as a print whose ink has not yet been pulled, never as void. (2) PRESSED INK, the ordinal direction, DOWN. Each of the five merged per-grade fill paths (they already exist as single paths, so this costs 10 extra DOM paths, not 694) gets a deboss treatment, a dark rim stroke offset 0.5 to 2px toward the light source and a pale relief stroke opposite, with offset depth quantized by grade rank in equal steps (A shallowest, D pressed deepest). At plan view this reads as engraving; when the camera tips oblique, a CSS custom property --lift (stepped 0/1, never scrubbed) additionally translates each grade group down by rank×1.5px so D visibly sinks. This is exactly the R7-approved quantized-rank form and it carries the R7 disclosure line on the page near ch0, stating depth shows rank in equal steps, not a measured quantity. (3) THE BILL, the magnitude direction, UP. Only dollar figures may rise. At the finale (a6-ledger, a6-climb, a6-bridge) the sourced dollar sums become deed-stacks, extruded isometric stacks of paper slivers where one sliver equals a fixed disclosed dollar amount, planted at their true geographic anchors (North Lawndale for the contract-sale overcharge, East Woodlawn for the present-day figures), drawn as SVG stacked rects inside the same rig so the tilted camera sees them stand off the plate. The dual is the thesis made physical, ordinal instruments press down, measured money piles up, and it is honest in both directions. WHERE 3D DELIBERATELY DOES NOT APPEAR: ch4, the bombing memorial, where dim=true forces --lift to 0, rims to flat, camera locked perpendicular (see ch4 field); and the register strip, which stays a flat instrument. Tilt itself appears exactly three times (see camera) so it stays an event, not a texture. Implementation: wrapper gets transform: perspective(1400px) rotateX(var(--tilt)) with --tilt stepped between 0deg, 14deg (flood), and 30deg (finale); transform-style flat is fine since relief is faked in-plane; SVG text labels hide or counter-skew during tilt states to avoid rasterized skewed type.
c.camera: Precondition build note: reproject the hydePark frame layers into citywide coordinates so all shots live in ONE space and every cut can become a move. The camera is a single inner <g data-rig> whose transform (scale+translate computed from a named shot list of viewBox rects, SHOTS['ch5-binga'] etc.) transitions via CSS, transition: transform 900ms cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.21,1). Linework uses vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; marks and the today ring counter-scale by a --zoom custom property so the 32 bombing dots hold ~4 screen px at every framing (kills the d-ch5 unreadable knot). Scroll NEVER scrubs a move; entering a step fires a fixed-duration transition and retargeting mid-flight is native to CSS transitions, so fast scrollers land clean. ACT BY ACT. act0 (ch0): first paint is the full plan-view citywide plate with lake and furniture, no motion, the shipped SSR win preserved; on the 'take the grades away' step the page's first tilt event, --tilt to 14deg while the five grade groups slide up 8px and fade, revealing bare pressed paper, then return to plan, the title-sequence moment. act1 (ch1-ch3, the township): the cut to Hyde Park becomes a 900ms dolly south-east; at ch1 the section grid draws on west to east (stroke-dashoffset, the 1830s survey drawing itself); at the 1893 beat the camera eases 20 percent tighter onto Jackson Park and the Midway as their real polygons light in hatch. act2 (a2-register overture): the map pane never goes bare again; it holds a dimmed plan citywide with whisper fabric while the loupe focus system ghosts across each instrument's real footprint as its wall row is reached (covenants near Washington Park and Woodlawn, renewal on the township line, contracts on North Lawndale). act3 (ch4 then ch5/a3): the rig arrives at the Black Belt framing BEFORE ch4 mounts (the move spends itself on the previous step's exit) so the memorial itself never moves; after ch4 releases, a3-f1..f3 is tilt event two, --tilt 14deg with a slow 8 percent push across the three flood steps while batches ink in filing order with an ink-soak entrance (opacity 0 to 1 with blur(0.4px) to 0, 250ms) and the corner date stamp ticks through the real sheet filing dates; a3-s1/s2 returns to plan and the loupe isolates the named sheet's polygon. act4 (courts and the basement): plan view, no tilt; the loupe carries the rerouting story, warm state unchanged. act5 (ch8-ch10, renewal): dolly into the township with the clearance footprint framing; at the contract-selling beats a full-commit zoom to North Lawndale, its first true close-up on the page. act6 (ch11, a6-sum, a6-ledger, a6-climb, a6-bridge): pull back to citywide for the sum, then tilt event three, the deepest oblique at 30deg as the deed-stacks rise at North Lawndale and East Woodlawn; the a6-climb 'three times the Black median' line becomes a measured height rule beside the stacks; the final ch11/bridge step returns to plan, today ring lit, the table seen flat one last time. REDUCED-MOTION RESOLUTION: every shot and tilt is a discrete resolved state in StageState (frame:string shot id, tilt: 0|14|30, lift: 0|1); prefers-reduced-motion sets transition:none and animation:none globally on the rig and flood batches, so keyboard, phone, and reduced-motion users step through the IDENTICAL resolved states as cuts, a static oblique being a state, not a motion. Nothing informational lives only in a tween.
c.groundPlane: Every layer names its source in the existing footnote/colophon system; nothing decorative is invented. Base stack present in ALL eras: the plate-mark and furniture (document, not geography), plus Lake Michigan as a true fill with shoreline line derived from the 77 community areas' eastern hull (data/exhibit-src/community-areas.geojson, City of Chicago portal, fetched 2026-07-10); the lake precedes every chapter so no state is ever bare cream, including the a2-register pane, which was the worst offender. Era ladder, toggled by data-era attributes with CSS opacity so DOM never changes: 1832 (ch1) lake + PLSS mile section grid (the 800-units-per-mile State/Madison arithmetic already trusted for bombing geocoding; the section lines ARE the 1830s instrument, era-appropriate by definition) + township boundary. 1893 lake + sections + real park polygons (hp-frame-layers.json 55 polygons and parks-cpd.geojson citywide) rendered as fine 45-degree SVG-pattern hatch in paper tones, never green since exh-green is reserved for the CBL credit; Jackson Park and the Midway light up as the fair's true footprint. 1900-1933 (ch4, ch5 pre-flood) + major-streets.geojson arterial skeleton at whisper weight and the 77-area community fabric as faint linework, giving the bombing marks and covenant beats a real city to sit on (fixes d-ch5's near-blank paper). 1934 onward, grades press on top of everything, fabric drops to 25 percent so pigment stays sovereign. 1955 (ch8) the renewal framing shows the township with parks hatched and the clearance-area boundary drawn from the plan geometry we hold, no invented rubble texture. 2026 (ch11, a6) full stack under the sum state so the township ghost, marks, and today ring sit on a whole city. Grade fill saturation citywide gets one honest correction, ink density raised roughly 15 percent toward the archival sheet's pigments so the opening reads as a city, not confetti.
c.register: Two drawings, one grammar, engraved like the plate. THE WALL (a2-register): five full-width lanes, each labeled by its full word in small caps at the lane head (REALTORS' RULE, COVENANTS, REDLINING, RENEWAL, CONTRACT SELLING) with begin and end years ticked at the bar ends and the court or statute that killed it marked with a double gavel tick and its real short name (SHELLEY 1948, code rewrite 1950, Fair Housing 1968). Where one instrument dies while its successor already runs, a vertical baton-pass tick connects end to running bar, so the relay is drawn as hand-offs, not implied. Beneath all five, a sixth UNION BAND, the boolean union of the spans, one solid unbroken bar from 1921 to 1970 with NO YEAR OFF, 1921 TO 1970 engraved along it. The thesis is now geometry a stranger reads in two seconds: five labeled bars, one unbroken band. Bars get the deboss rim treatment for cohesion with the map ink. THE DOCKED STRIP: grows from ~30px of hairlines to a 64px instrument (56 mobile). Five 5px lanes with their word labels in the leading gutter (no more floating single letters), the 8px union band beneath, decade ticks, and the playhead as an ink vertical with a year chip; the active chapter's instrument lane brightens and baton ticks draw as the story crosses them. Rust appears exactly once on the strip, the 2026 terminus tick, preserving rust-means-now. Mobile taps a lane to reveal its full label and span as a one-line tooltip.
newIdeas: The deed-stack: finale dollar figures rendered as countable stacks of paper slivers at true geographic anchors, one sliver equals a fixed disclosed amount, replacing the quiet a6 charts with a physical bill the tilted camera looks across; magnitude is honest because you can count it.
The filing-date ticker: the corner date stamp advances through the real sheet filing dates during a3-f1..f3, turning the flood's batch order into a legible clerical rhythm instead of subtle stipple.

The surveyor's loupe: a global focus state (data-focus with area ids) that lifts named polygons to full ink with a 1.5px screen-space outline while the rest of the plate drops to a ghost via opacity on the non-focus group (opacity, not SVG filters, for Safari perf); used for Binga's block, the named sheets, the clearance footprint, North Lawndale, East Woodlawn.

Document furniture as detail: the HOLC sheet's transcribed title block, a grid-derived scale bar, north arrow, and debossed plate-mark, so 'hyper-detailed' is satisfied with real archival furniture rather than fake geography.
The survey pulse: PLSS section lines draw themselves west to east at ch1 via stroke-dashoffset, the 1830s instrument performing its own arrival; reduced motion shows them resolved.
Baton-pass verticals and the union band on both registers: the relay drawn as literal hand-offs plus one unbroken 1921-1970 bar, converting the page's central claim from a sentence into a shape.
Ink-soak entrances: flood batches arrive with a 250ms blur-and-opacity settle that reads as ink absorbing into paper, presentation-only and removed under reduced motion.
Screen-space marks: bombing dots and the today ring counter-scale against --zoom so they hold constant pixel size at every framing, ending the sub-2px knot permanently.
c.ch4AndHonesty: ch4: the camera completes its move on the PREVIOUS step's exit so the memorial mounts already framed and never moves; dim=true hard-forces --tilt:0, --lift:0, rims flat, loupe off, and suppresses all transitions within the chapter, so the only permitted motion is the existing slow dim fade-up. The reframe is compositional only, the Black Belt shot shifts wider and east so the 32 marks and the dashed commission square occupy the right third with air, the count set as quiet wall text in the left third; marks stay matte ink at fixed screen size, no glow, no relief, dead counted, not named. HONESTY: every layer is enumerated with its source in the colophon (HOLC polygons from geometry.json, shoreline and 77-area fabric from community-areas.geojson, parks from parks-cpd.geojson and hp-frame-layers.json, streets from major-streets.geojson, section grid from the surveyed 800-units-per-mile arithmetic, 32 located bombings, sheet filing dates, sourced dollar figures, title block transcribed from the archival sheet). Grade depth is quantized rank with the R7 disclosure line on the page; only dollars extrude with magnitude, each stack captioned with its per-sliver value and source. No texture, terrain, or building fabric we do not hold ever appears; the 694 area paths remain untouched DOM tap targets; animation is presentation, information lives entirely in resolved discrete states.
c.risks: (1) Reprojecting the hydePark frame into citywide coordinates is the load-bearing prerequisite for the continuous camera; budget it first and keep the old hard-cut path as fallback per frame. (2) Skewed SVG text under tilt rasterizes badly; hide or counter-transform labels in tilt states, and cap mobile tilt at 20deg with perspective 1000px. (3) Deboss rims may read too subtle at plan view; tune rim contrast against the raised ink density and blind-test the ch0 screenshot before committing. (4) Transitioning transform on a rig containing 694 paths is GPU-composited and should hold 60fps, but Safari must be profiled with the ghost states using opacity only, never feColorMatrix on large groups. (5) Taste risk both directions, the owner asked for spectacle while the page's register is a historian's; the three-tilt scarcity rule is the guardrail, and if review finds it timid the correct dial is tilt depth and finale stack presence, never adding motion to ch4 or scrubbing the scroll. (6) Scope: build in three gates, camera plus ground plane, then relief and loupe, then finale stacks and registers, each behind the existing verify suite so a partial ship is still a coherent ship.

c.thesis: The visitor stops reading a diagram about Chicago and finds themselves leaning over the surveyor's actual sheet on a work table, watching a century press its marks down into the paper and, at the end, watching the bill rise back out of it in dollars.
c.threeD: ONE language, paper depth on a drafting table, with exactly two honest depth encodings and one camera. (1) INTAGLIO GRADES, depth INTO the paper. The four merged per-grade fills get four static SVG filters (feOffset of SourceAlpha, feComposite operator="out", feFlood in a darkened ink, composited atop the fill; depth steps 0 / 0.75 / 1.5 / 2.25 px at base scale) so A sits proud and D is pressed deepest, like plate engraving. This is quantized ordinal rank in four discrete steps, the R7-approved honest form, with a printed plat-margin disclosure in the new title block ("Depth shows grade rank, four steps, not measured magnitude. Source: HOLC 1940"). Filters apply to the 4 merged fills only, never the 694 tap-target paths, which stay transparent DOM hit layers above. Fallback if mobile filter cost bites: the R7 stacked-offset 2.5D geometry, same four steps. (2) DOLLAR TOWERS, height OUT of the paper, finale only. Ledger, climb, and gap figures have true magnitude, so they extrude as flat-shaded oblique prisms (top parallelogram + two faces, drawn in SVG) anchored at North Lawndale and East Woodlawn, height linear in dollars against a printed scale bar naming units and source. The 2026 gap tower alone is rust, because rust means present-day. (3) THE TABLE. The whole sheet lives in an HTML wrapper: .stage-camera { perspective: 1200px; perspective-origin: 50% 40% } around .stage-sheet { transform: rotateX(var(--tilt)) scale(var(--zoom)) translate3d(var(--pan)); transition: transform 900ms cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); will-change: transform }. c.threeD: ONE language, depth as evidence of pressure, with a strict down/up semantic. (1) DOWN, ordinal, quantized: the four grade fills are debossed INTO the paper as intaglio relief. This is the R7-approved honest form, quantized rank steps, and it ships with an on-page disclosure: depth shows grade rank, four equal steps, not measured magnitude. The relief does not exist from first paint. It arrives once, at the doctrine step (a3-s2, "the city's doctrine had become the country's underwriting"), as a single discrete press state (data-press="on"): the map was inked in the flood, then pressed into the ground. One state change, 400ms shadow-deepen, cut under reduced motion. (2) THE TABLE: the whole stage sits in an HTML wrapper with perspective: 1400px, transform-origin 50% 60%; each StageState carries a discrete tilt token, plumb 0deg / reading 8deg / examining 14deg, applied as rotateX on the inner plane with will-change: transform. Tilt is grammar, not garnish. Tilted means the conservator is examining; plumb means testimony (memorial, deed facsimile, receipt, colophon). Labels stay legible because 14deg is the ceiling; test on Safari before locking. (3) UP, true magnitude only: at a6-climb and a6-bridge, dollar figures extrude as isometric SVG prisms rising out of the paper at their real anchors (East Woodlawn), three-face polygons (lit top, two shaded sides) sharing the stage's tilt so map and columns read as one world. The memorial chapter suspends everything: tilt plumb, press visually flattened by the dim field rendering above the relief shadows, marks in flat ink, zero motion. Depth is for instruments and dollars, never for the dead.

The 1832 grid overture. The first thing ever pressed into the blank paper at ch1 is the PLSS section grid, the 1830s survey instrument itself, so the exhibit opens by showing that the surveying came before the city.
c.ch4AndHonesty: ch4 is the control case that proves the language. The camera arrives at the recentered Black Belt crop one step early and settles plumb, so the memorial chapter contains zero movement of any kind; the dim field renders above the relief shadows and visually flattens the press; the 32 marks and the dashed commission square are flat ink at full screen-constant size; the recomposed crop centers the marks' centroid and the commission square on the right-third line, fixing the left-hugging composition through the viewBox, not decoration; the only permitted change remains the existing slow static reveal, a cut under reduced motion; dead are counted, not named. Every layer in the concept is real data with a named source: shoreline and fabric from community-areas.geojson, parks from parks-cpd.geojson and hp-frame-layers.json, streets from major-streets.geojson, the section grid from the same State/Madison arithmetic that geocodes the bombings, prism heights from the sourced ledger and gap dollar figures in the 127-fact registry. The two purely material treatments, water lining and a sub-3-percent paper grain on the paper rect, encode nothing, are conventions of the medium, and are declared as such in the colophon. Grade depth is quantized ordinal with an on-page disclosure; continuous grade extrusion stays dead. Nothing on the map is invented, and nothing invented is on the map.
c.risks: Safari and mobile performance of SVG inner-shadow filters under a CSS perspective transform is the top technical risk; it is bounded because filters touch only the four merged grade paths, but it needs a device test before the press moment is locked, with a graceful fallback of pre-flattened duotone edge strokes. Text legibility under rotateX degrades fast past about 15 degrees; 14deg is the hard ceiling and labels must be reviewed at that angle. The intaglio effect risks being too subtle to satisfy an owner who asked for spectacle; the concept banks its drama on the press moment, the spotlight pigment contrast, and the finale prisms, and if a blind taste test still reads flat, deepen shadow tokens before reaching for any new mechanism. The prisms must never migrate upstream to grade data; enforce the four-token depth scale and the dollars-only extrusion rule in code review, because that is exactly where a well-meaning build pass would quietly break the honesty that survived R7. Finally, the 694 tap targets must stay above the relief layer in hit-test order; verify the suite still resolves every area after the camera group wraps them.

c.conceptName: Pressed Ground (the plate and the bill)
c.thesis: The visitor stops seeing a pale diagram beside an essay and starts seeing one physical object, an engraver's plate lying on a desk that the camera leans over and dives into, where a century of policy is pressed DOWN into the paper as depth and the present-day bill is the only thing that rises UP off it, so the last screen (rust ring pressed into the sheet, dollar towers standing off the tilted plate) is the thesis as a single screenshot.
c.threeD: ONE language, "the plate": the map is a physical sheet on a drafting desk, and depth means pressure of policy. Three coordinated techniques, no WebGL, no new dependencies, SSR untouched. (1) THE DESK AND SHEET. The stage wrapper becomes a CSS 3D scene: .ground-scene { perspective: 1400px } with the map plane on .ground-plate { transform: rotateX(var(--tilt)); transform-style: preserve-3d }. Tilt is a discrete per-step value set by StageController as a data attribute: 0deg for reading/memorial states, 10deg resting desk angle, 22deg for overview and finale moments (mobile caps at 8deg to preserve pane height). The sheet itself gets a plate mark: a rectangular sheet boundary inside the SVG with a soft drop shadow onto a cream-dark desk surface, so the map is never confetti floating in cream, it is paper with edges lying on a table. (2) INTAGLIO GRADES, pressed down. The four merged per-grade fills (already in geometry.json, critically NOT the 694 individual paths, which stay as unfiltered transparent tap targets above) get an inner-shadow press filter: feOffset + feGaussianBlur + feComposite operator="out" composited back at four QUANTIZED depth steps, A shallowest to D deepest (dy roughly 0.6 / 1.1 / 1.7 / 2.4 viewBox units, userSpaceOnUse), plus richer ink saturation than today's pastels. This is the R7-approved honest form: ordinal rank as discrete steps, with the on-page disclosure line "depth shows grade rank, not a measured quantity" in the plate's margin. Grade colors still mean grades only. (3) DOLLAR TOWERS, rising up, true magnitude only. At the finale the ledger / climb / bridge figures extrude as HTML prisms standing perpendicular to the tilted plate: absolutely positioned divs at anchor percentages (same math as notePos today), height linear in real dollars with a labeled scale, transform: rotateX(calc(-1 * var(--tilt))) with transform-origin bottom so they stand up off the plane while the map tilts under them; labels billboard flat to the camera. Grades may never extrude upward; dollars may never press downward. WHERE THE LANGUAGE DELIBERATELY DOES NOT APPEAR: ch4, the bombing memorial, is tilt 0deg, no press filter, no towers, no plate shadow emphasis, flat matte ink on a dim field, exactly the one place on the page where the paper refuses to perform.
c.camera: The three hard viewBox cuts die. The viewBox is fixed at the citywide crop forever; all map layers move inside one <g data-camera-rig> driven by CSS custom properties (--cam-tx, --cam-ty, --cam-k; transform-origin: 0 0; transition: transform 900ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.21, 1); will-change only during transition). Linework uses vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; marks are screen-constant (StageController sets r per state, floor 4.5 screen px). Every one of the 54 steps maps to exactly one resolved camera tuple (tx, ty, k, tilt, spotlight anchor) in a single states table that the verify suite snapshots, so "check every map" becomes mechanical. Choreography by anchor: act0 / ch0, camera opens at citywide, resting 10deg tilt, plate and lake visible at first paint (SSR win preserved since the opening state is the server default). ch1 to ch3, the camera pushes into the Hyde Park township (about 4x) as the section grid fades up; at the 1893 beat it slides to frame Jackson Park and the Midway, labeled as the fairground. Entering ch4 there is ZERO motion: the camera pre-settles on the recomposed Black Belt crop during the previous step's resolve, so the memorial is discovered already framed, marks recentered to the right-of-center golden section instead of hugging the left third. ch5, the camera closes to about 8x on the marks cluster; the citywide count badge ("32 bombings, 1917 to 1921") resolves into individually readable, tappable dots as it arrives, with a spotlight vignette (full-bleed rect with a radial SVG mask hole, cream-dark at 0.45) holding Binga's block. a2-register, the map pane is never bare again: it holds the grounded citywide plate and, row by row as the wall introduces each instrument, spotlights the real geometry we actually have (M: the D fills; U: the township boundary; S: the North Lawndale community-area polygon; R and C stay document-anchored in their existing facsimile scenes, no fake footprints). a3-f1 to f3, the flood becomes the hero: camera starts tight on the first filed sheet's area and pulls back continuously across the three steps as ink spreads in filing order, ending citywide exactly as the map completes; at a3-s2 ("graded hazardous") the whole sheet takes THE PRESS, one 800ms full-map moment where the intaglio depth arrives and the plate darkens 4 percent. ch8, camera at township, moderate tilt, spotlight ring on the Hyde Park-Kenwood plan area inside the boundary. ch11 and a6-sum, the page's one full journey: citywide slowly descends to the East Woodlawn rust ring (the "same map" landing). a6-ledger / a6-climb / a6-bridge, tilt goes to 22deg and the dollar towers rise; a6-climb reads as a cross-section, one short pressed bar against one tall rising bar with a physical bracket labeled "three times the Black median." REDUCED-MOTION RESOLUTION: prefers-reduced-motion sets every transition and the press animation to 0ms; keyboard stepping, phone scroll, and reduced motion all land on the identical resolved state table; tilt still renders (it is composition, not information) but never animates; no scroll-linked continuous transforms anywhere, only state-triggered eases, so the page stays an honest scrolling document. Safari fallback: if CSS transform on the SVG group misbehaves, a rAF viewBox interpolator reads the same state table.
c.groundPlane: Server-rendered layers in StageBase, paint order desk, sheet, lake, grid, parks, whisper fabric, grade fills, tap paths, boundaries, marks, labels, spotlight, ring; each toggled by the existing data-attribute mechanism; every layer names its file source in the colophon. Per era: ch0 and all 1934-2026 citywide states get the full ground: lake fill with a fine horizontal ruled-line SVG pattern (an honest cartographic convention, not invented detail) and true shoreline from the eastern hull of community-areas.geojson (City of Chicago), the 77 community areas as whisper linework, the named parks, and intaglio grade fills. ch1 (1833) is honest bare ground that is not bare cream: the PLSS mile section grid (the 1830s survey instrument itself, the same 800-units-per-mile State/Madison arithmetic already used to geocode the bombings), shoreline, ruled lake, township boundary; the grid IS the first taking. The 1893 beat adds Jackson Park, Washington Park, and the Midway from the 55 currently unused park polygons in hp-frame-layers.json, with Jackson Park labeled as the fairground site (real fact, real geometry). 1917 to 1921 states (ch4, ch5) keep lake plus faded section grid at the Black Belt crop, because the grid is the very lattice the incidents were geocoded against; ch4 renders it at whisper opacity only. ch8 (1955) gets the grounded township: shoreline, lake, section grid, parks, boundary, spotlight on the plan area; we have no clearance parcel geometry so we draw none. 2026 states add the rust ring and present-day labels (North Lawndale, East Woodlawn). Parks are Chicago Park District present-day boundaries and the margin source note says so. No state on the page ever again shows a floating label on empty cream (a2-register's left pane and ch5 were the worst offenders; both are cured by the plate plus era ground plus spotlight).
c.register: The dock stops being five 1px hairlines with cryptic initials and becomes THE UNION BAND, because the stranger does not need five instruments in two seconds, they need one claim: the machinery never turned off. Dock (44px desktop, 32px mobile): a year rail 1900-2026 with 20-year ticks, one 6px continuous pressed-ink bar spanning 1921-1970 carrying the label "NO YEAR OFF, 1921-1970" set inside it once act 2 has introduced it, thinner post-1970 runs for renewal (1952 to now) and contract selling's return after 2008, and an ink caret riding the current story year (the caret turns rust only when the year is 2026, preserving rust = present-day). Tapping the dock expands the five-row wall as a bottom sheet. The WALL (a2-register) draws the relay instead of stating it: the five bars become pressed intaglio bands in the same plate language, each stamping in on scroll with its specimen tag (the code, the deed, the map, the bulldozer, the contract); at each court-closure year (1948, 1950, 1968, 1970) a vertical baton line drops from the dying bar to the bar already running; then a sixth derived row PRINTS beneath them, the union of the five, one unbroken 1921-1970 bar, and the sentence "no year the machinery was off" sets inside the drawn bar rather than in a paragraph below. Two-second read at any scroll position: five short bars collapse into one long dark bar, and a caret tells you where in that bar you are standing.
newIdeas: The press/rise duality as the page's physical grammar: policy presses DOWN into the paper (quantized intaglio depth), the outstanding bill is the only thing that rises UP (true-magnitude HTML towers standing off the tilted plane); the visitor feels the asymmetry before reading a word

THE PRESS: a single full-map 800ms moment at a3-s2 where the completed 1940 survey visibly stamps into the sheet (depth shadows arrive, plate darkens 4 percent), turning 'graded hazardous' into a physical event rather than a caption

Semantic zoom for the bombing marks: at citywide the 32 incidents aggregate into one labeled count badge that resolves into individually readable, tappable dots as the camera closes at ch5, killing the sub-2-pixel knot without inventing geometry

Wet-ink filing in the flood: each batch lands at full ink saturation and settles to its resting grade tone in 600ms while the camera pulls back in filing order, so the map audibly 'fills' the way the sheets were filed

The union band, a derived sixth row that visually sums the five instrument bars into one unbroken 1921-1970 bar with baton verticals at each court closure, converting the relay thesis from stated text to drawn proof, then riding the bottom dock for the rest of the page
The plate mark and desk: giving the sheet physical edges and a shadow onto a cream-dark desk, which cures every bare-cream state at the cost of two rects and one filter

The climb as a cross-section: the finale income chart rebuilt in the extrusion vocabulary, one pressed bar versus one rising bar with a physical bracket labeled 'three times the Black median', a two-second read that is also the sharable frame

A single resolved-states table (camera tuple, tilt, spotlight, layers) as the one source of truth for all 54 steps, which the verify suite snapshots so 'check every map' is a diffable artifact, not a vibe
c.ch4AndHonesty: ch4 is the language's deliberate silence: tilt locked at 0deg, no press filter, no spotlight vignette, no towers, no wet-ink, flat matte marks on the existing dim field, and the camera pre-settles on the recomposed crop during the preceding step so entering the memorial involves zero motion; the only change it receives is compositional, the Black Belt viewBox re-centered so the 32 marks and the dashed commission square sit right-of-center with room to breathe, and the section grid at whisper opacity so the dead are located on the same real lattice that geocoded them. Dead stay counted, not named. Every layer in the concept is real and names its source: shoreline and whisper fabric from community-areas.geojson (City of Chicago), parks from parks-cpd.geojson (Chicago Park District) and the 55 polygons in hp-frame-layers.json, the section grid from the State/Madison PLSS arithmetic already used for bombing geocoding, grades from the 694 HOLC polygons and their merged per-grade fills, filing order from the sheet dates, dollars from the sourced ledger figures. The lake's ruled-line texture is a drafting convention applied to a real shoreline, not invented coastline detail. Depth is ordinal rank in four quantized steps with the margin disclosure, never continuous; only dollars, which have true magnitude, extrude, with a labeled linear scale. Rust appears solely on 2026 states (ring, caret at 2026, East Woodlawn label). The 694 paths remain untouched DOM tap targets above the filtered merged fills, so the sheet lookups and the verify suite keep working.
c.risks: (1) Performance: animating scale on a group containing 694 paths plus new ground layers can jank on low-end phones; mitigate with one transform on one group, will-change scoped to the transition window, server-side geometry simplification for the whisper fabric (target under 60KB of new path data), and press filters on exactly four merged fills, never per-area. (2) Safari SVG CSS-transform quirks (transform-origin on inner groups); the rAF viewBox interpolator reading the same state table is the tested fallback, budget a day for it. (3) Taste risk: intaglio depth too subtle reads as nothing, too strong reads as skeuomorphic kitsch; gate it with an R7-style blind taste test on d-ch0, d-a3-s2, and d-a6-climb before act-wide rollout. (4) Tilt versus legibility: SVG labels tilt with the plane; cap tilt at 22deg (8deg mobile), bump label sizes, and keep the era readout and stage notes in the existing HTML overlay which never tilts. (5) Camera motion versus document honesty: keep every move state-triggered and under 900ms, never scroll-linked, or the page starts feeling hijacked and the R9 covenant breaks. (6) Scope: the flood pull-back, semantic zoom, and the union band are each a real build; if the round must cut, cut tilt animation (ship static tilts) before cutting the camera, the ground plane, or the register, which are the three things a stranger notices in the first 90 seconds.
